name: Tokyo Energy & Systems Inc.
summary: Tokyo Energy & Systems Inc. engages in the planning, study, design, construction, and supervision of electric and mechanical facilities in Japan. The company constructs thermal and nuclear power, hydro-electric power, chemical, and industrial plants, as well as substations, environmental facilities, and building and housing projects. It is also involved in the planning, study, design, and construction of telecommunication systems and electronic facilities; design and construction of civil and architectural facilities; and manufacture, sale, and leasing of mechanical equipment, materials, and fuels.
